extraction_notes: Fig. 7 is the main source for the CuO-loading and temperature series; values not printed in text were read approximately from labelled plotted points. The paper also contains Table 2 comparing literature catalysts; only the 'This work' CuO/Ce0.4Zr0.6O2 row was used, and literature rows were excluded. Table 2 reports methanol yield (YCH3OH), not methanol STY, so no STY was extracted. Fig. 8 plots methanol selectivity as a function of CO2 conversion for selected catalysts, but the operating variable used to change conversion is not stated; those secondary/derived comparison points were not added as separate catalyst-condition records.
